copy:
I was never unsure of you.
I was lost inside our life.
visual: COVER HERO, impossible overhead-oblique wide shot. Exactly Aachu and Zuv stand full length together on the one calm square of an ivory-paper apartment floor while the rooms around them fold upward into a vast architectural maze: doorframes, half-walls and stair landings curve into storm-blue watercolor distance. They face the maze but turn slightly toward each other, shoulders touching, and hold only one shared rolled floor plan low between them. A single terracotta route line begins straight beneath both pairs of feet, then tangles only after it enters the surrounding house. Their joined location is stable; the life around them is bewildering. Both faces remain readable and recognizably anchored. No embrace, no literal heart, no duplicated couple, no reflections, no extra people. Reserve the upper-left and upper-middle ivory sky for the exact two-line copy.
emotion: vertigo around the life, complete certainty in the person
pose: Full-length same-depth two-shot, exactly two-inch height difference. Their outer shoulders angle toward the maze while inner shoulders touch. Aachu's right hand and Zuv's left hand each hold one separate end of the same rolled floor plan at waist height; their free hands remain fully out of frame behind their own bodies. Their gaze first meets for certainty, then follows the maze direction.
wardrobe: Aachu: charcoal-grey blazer, ivory top, graphite trousers, long dark hair loose. Zuv: charcoal-black shirt, dark trousers, short natural beard, thick dark hair.
props: one shared rolled floor plan, one terracotta floor route line, impossible ivory-paper home architecture
continuity_lock: The same house, wardrobe and terracotta line continue. The line is straight only under the couple here and tangles after entering the house.
cta_intent: The contradiction should stop the scroll before the viewer reads twice.

copy:
Choosing each other had answered
the easiest question.
visual: INTIMATE LOW FLOOR-LEVEL MEDIUM SHOT at the threshold of the impossible paper house. Exactly Aachu and Zuv step across the same threshold together in synchronized motion. Their nearest feet land on the same clean terracotta route line; behind their ankles a single closed apartment door sits simple and calm, while ahead the corridor branches out of focus. Each carries one end of the same rolled floor plan, lowered between them like a shared decision rather than a romantic pose. Their eyes are on each other, not the corridor, and both show a tiny relieved smile. The decisive information is the simultaneous step and shared object. No key, ring close-up, altar, heart icon, extra door label, background figure, reflection or extra hand. Clean upper-middle paper space for copy.
emotion: one choice is calm even before the rest is known
pose: Low angle shows both full lower bodies and readable faces. Aachu's right hand holds her end of the rolled plan; her left hand stays in her blazer pocket. Zuv's left hand holds his end; his right hand stays in his trouser pocket. Both step forward at once, feet separate and anatomically clear.

props: one rolled floor plan, one simple closed door behind them, one straight terracotta route line under their feet
continuity_lock: They have entered the shared house. The plan is still rolled because the question of who came before the questions of how.

copy:
Some days, love did not tell us
what to do.
visual: MOST DRAMATIC FRAME, overhead three-quarter view of the living-room floor during an indigo watercolor storm. Exactly Aachu and Zuv kneel on opposite sides of the now-unrolled single floor plan, separated by the paper but still inside the same pool of lamplight. The plan is blank except for one visibly tangled terracotta route line; it contains no words, icons or symbols. Aachu holds only her lower-left corner with her right hand while her left palm rests flat on her own thigh. Zuv holds only his lower-right corner with his left hand while his right palm rests flat on his own thigh. They are not fighting: both gaze at the same knot in the line with tired, honest bewilderment, shoulders lowered. Around them, the room's walls dissolve into rain-blue maze washes, but every body edge stays separate from furniture and paper. One practical lamp between them gives warm light without tinting the ivory paper. No touching across the map, pointing, shouting, tears, extra arms, extra people, reflections, letters, compass, heart or solution arrow. Reserve clean upper-left paper for exact copy.
pose: Overhead three-quarter two-person kneeling tableau. The unrolled map makes distance visible but does not split the page. Aachu owns one visible right hand on one map corner and one visible left hand on her own thigh. Zuv owns one visible left hand on the opposite corner and one visible right hand on his own thigh. Faces three-quarter and large enough for identity review.
wardrobe: Same locked wardrobe, sleeves and fabric folds fully traceable against the floor.
props: one unrolled blank floor plan, one tangled terracotta route line, one low practical lamp, dissolving indigo paper-house walls
continuity_lock: The same plan from slides 1-2 is finally opened. Its route is tangled, not wrong. This is the proof slide for identity, anatomy, spatial integrity, text, palette and story.
cta_intent: A viewer should recognize a day when love remained present but offered no instructions.

copy:
Being lost together did not mean
I had chosen wrong.
visual: CLOSE SIDE-PROFILE REACTION SHOT at the same map, after the storm. Exactly Aachu and Zuv now sit back-to-back on the floor at the center of the maze, each supporting the other's weight. The tangled plan lies open beside their hips, still visibly unsolved. Aachu exhales with eyes closed and a small relieved smile; Zuv tilts his head back just enough to rest against hers, also softened. Their separate outside hands each hold a simple charcoal pencil down by their own knee, ready but not yet drawing; their inside hands are fully hidden. The terracotta line stops at their backs and begins again on the other side as one calmer stroke, showing that closeness changed the meaning before it changed the problem. No embrace, no rescue pose, no literal heart, no magic glow around bodies, no duplicate hands or people. Clean ivory upper-middle space for copy.
emotion: the first breath after mistaking uncertainty for failure
pose: Tight seated side-profile pair, backs and heads making believable contact. Each person has exactly one visible outside hand holding one pencil loosely by their own knee; the other hand is fully hidden. Legs and clothing remain clearly separate from the plan and wall lines.
wardrobe: Same locked wardrobe with natural rumpling from sitting on the floor.
props: one open unsolved plan, two simple charcoal pencils, the terracotta line changing from tangled to calm across their shared back-to-back contact
continuity_lock: Nothing is solved yet. The turn is that their shared disorientation no longer reads as evidence against the choice.
cta_intent: This is the emotional line people send when they need language for staying.

copy:
Commitment answered who.
We are still learning how.
visual: DAWN RELEASE, low rear three-quarter wide shot from inside the unfinished paper house. Exactly Aachu and Zuv walk forward side by side through an open roofline into cool morning ivory. Each holds one end of a taut charcoal chalk line at hip height, using it together to mark the next straight segment of the terracotta route across the blank floor ahead. Their pace is synchronized but the path visibly stops before the horizon: no finished destination, only the next authored section. The old maze remains behind them in soft indigo wash; the rolled plan is tucked under Zuv's left arm and fully separate from his torso. Aachu looks ahead; Zuv looks briefly toward her with a small grounded smile. The dawn stays neutral ivory, not yellow. No heart-shaped shadow, house-shaped aura, finish flag, arrows, signage, extra people, reflections or fantasy portals. Exact copy sits in generous upper-middle negative space; tiny @a.storyof.two at top-right.
pose: Full-length walking two-shot from rear three-quarter angle, same depth and exact two-inch height difference. Aachu's right hand holds her end of the chalk line; her left hand stays in her pocket. Zuv's right hand holds his end; his left arm secures the one rolled plan. Their arms, wrists and line contacts remain anatomically separate and visible.
wardrobe: Same locked wardrobe, softened by dawn light without changing colors.
props: one shared charcoal chalk line, one rolled floor plan under Zuv's left arm, one unfinished terracotta path, soft indigo maze behind
continuity_lock: The plan remains with them, but the final route is being drawn by both in real time. The terracotta line is now authored rather than discovered.
cta_intent: A complete, screenshot-worthy thesis that resolves certainty versus uncertainty without pretending marriage supplies instructions.
